description: Ambient air-quality monitoring (UCI Beijing multi-site hourly measurements, replayed)
source: REAL: UCI Beijing Multi-Site Air Quality (Chen 2017, DOI 10.24432/C5RK5G, CC BY 4.0), hourly, 2016-12-01 00:00 + 500 h. Nodes 1-12 = the 12 station streams (alphabetical); nodes 13-200 = virtual REPLAY nodes, node k replays station ((k-1) mod 12)+1.

columns.scenario_id: A water, B effluent, C air, D soil
columns.node_id: 1..200, same node ids and positions as the 200-node OMNeT++ topology
columns.sim_time_s: OMNeT++ round start, (round-1) x 100 s (V2_200Node roundPeriod)
columns.env_time: environmental time: KSPCB sampling date of the carried sample / Beijing local hour / T+hours since synthetic origin
columns.source_station_id: station or virtual source stream the node reports
columns.is_replayed: 1 = virtual node replaying another real stream
columns.quality_flag: 'ok' or ';'-separated flags (missing:<field>, sensor_outage, no_observation_yet, DO_invalid_value, pm10_lt_pm25_in_source, chem_not_scheduled)
columns.anomaly_flag: synthetic: 1 inside an injected abnormal event or glitch (ground truth); real: = alarm_flag (no ground truth)
columns.alarm_flag: 1 if any profile alarm threshold is exceeded by this round value
columns.event_type: ground-truth event label (synthetic) or observed-exceedance label (real)
columns.m1_report: Mode 1 (controlled): 1 = report slot of the validated 200-node workload (identical mask in all scenarios), 4000-bit packet
columns.m2_fields: measurement fields in the Mode 2 payload
columns.m2_payload_bytes: application payload = 10 B header + 2 B per present field
columns.m2_frame_bits: 8 x (17 B IEEE 802.15.4 PHY+MAC overhead + payload)
columns.m2_sensing_mJ: sensing + processing energy of this round (mJ), from sensor_profiles.json energy entries

PM10_ugm3.valid_rule: >= 0; PM10 >= PM2.5 checked and flagged, not altered

RH_pct.hardware: Sensirion SHT45 (same measurement); dataset RH derived from TEMP and DEWP (Magnus formula)

sampling.note: PM sensor woken 4x per hour (30 s warm-up each), gas sensors continuously biased and averaged; dataset gives one hourly value
sampling.round_note: Mode 2 network epoch = 1 h of environmental time for air, effluent and soil. The water stream keeps the unchanged MATLAB V2 KSPCB schedule (212 sampling dates -> 1000 rounds; rounds 1-500 simulated), so one water round is a schedule slot, not a fixed hour.

alarms.source: India NAAQS 2009: PM2.5 60 ug/m3 (24 h); applied to the hourly value as a conservative screening trigger
India NAAQS 2009: PM10 100 ug/m3 (24 h); hourly screening
India NAAQS 2009: NO2 80 ug/m3 (24 h); hourly screening
India NAAQS 2009: SO2 80 ug/m3 (24 h); hourly screening

missing_value_policy: missing = empty cell, listed in quality_flag; never converted to 0. Mode 1 still sends the slot (missing fields flagged in the packet); Mode 2 sends only present fields and skips a round with none.
